{{Quote|The transit tax made it difficult for refugees to go to the capital. These new ventures may make it altogether impossible, but I guess that's Coruscant's intent, isn't it?|Bronwynn Koft|<ref name="HNN 51">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_1.html|Coruscant Restricts Immigration}}</ref>}}
'''Bronwynn Koft''' was [[Vice President/Legends|Vice President]] of the [[Galaxy Tours/Legends|Galaxy Tours]] starline and spoke out against the [[transit tax]] shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
